inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL REGEXP predicate uses a word boundary to find a token prefix inside a space-separated text field.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored scalar security-label predicate so REGEXP matching, NULL behavior, and the MySQL/MariaDB boolean result are isolated without the routing update.

fixture_notes: The label starts with SEC100 and must match the SEC1 word-boundary prefix.
determinism_notes: The scalar literal and projected alias are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
